observation.command:
TOK=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=admin-cli" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" | jq -r .access_token) && echo $TOK > /tmp/kc-token.txt && echo "$TOK" | cut -d. -f2 | tr -d '
' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq '{exp, iat}'; echo "current epoch: $(date +%s)"; PROBE_ID=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[] | select(.clientId=="probe2") | .id') && echo "probe2 id: $PROBE_ID" && curl -s -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$PROBE_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -w "
HTTP:%{http_code}
"
